title_zh: 把剧院筹款承诺与到账款项分开记录

scenario.label_zh: 把剧院筹款承诺与到账款项分开记录
scenario.goal_zh: 核对支持者的捐款承诺尚未到账，并约定只在承诺栏记录而不计入可用资金

context_zh: 虚构社区剧院的两位志愿者核对筹款记录，纯属财务沟通练习。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Val
sentences.text: A patron of the theatre has sent a pledge of two hundred pounds. Can I add it to the money available for the new curtains?

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: Has the payment arrived, or have we only received the promise?

sentences.speaker: Val
sentences.text: Only the promise. Her message says she plans to pay next month.

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: Then put it in the pledges column, not the amount received. We can’t spend it yet.

sentences.speaker: Val
sentences.text: Understood. I’ll record the two hundred as promised and leave our available total unchanged.

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: Good. We’ll move it across if the payment comes in.
